name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a foreclosed property rehab?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a foreclosed property rehab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before bringing in a contractor, secure clear legal access to the building, gather all inspection reports, and establish a clear scope of work. Determine your ultimate goal for the property, such as moving in as a primary residence or preparing it for rental use, as this directs finish selections and budgeting. If utilities have been shut off, coordinate with local utility providers to restore electrical and water access so systems can be tested. Having a prioritized punch list of visible damage helps the contractor deliver a precise, itemized remodeling estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure legal property access, restore essential utilities for testing, review inspection reports, and identify your priority repairs and overall budget.
